verdict.rationale: Lovable documents an official MCP server through which your own AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code and deploy apps from its own client, so an external agent can drive the builder alongside the built-in one (lovable-docs-37). Git sync covers the 'instead of' path: you can edit locally and push, and the changes sync back into Lovable (lovable-docs-9, lovable-docs-33). Missing for 10: detailed docs on the MCP server's tool surface, auth and permissions; any hands-on or independent corroboration of external agents driving projects; and explicit guidance on running a local coding agent against the synced repo.
